Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
I'll be at Gen Con this year (in Milwaukee, the 7th through 10th
of August)

Besides being at the two VtES tourneys (in LHQ-3 at 10am Fri and
12noon Sat), I'll be around Thursday, if anyone needs to find me
for whatever reason.

You can leave a message for me at the WotC booth (I'll check by
there periodically), and my room-hopping schedule Thursday is:

10am EB231
12noon M27
4pm M37

So, if anyone wants to play some VtES (especially if you'd like
to help me teach some newbies the game) let me know via e-mail
or just find me there.

(and bring some low-key decks - you know what I mean. Effective
strategies are OK: Malk S&B, Brujah Rush, etc. but degenerate
decks won't go over well: EuroBrujah TB, etc.).

I will be bringing my usual esoteric decks, so don't worry too
much about me. (JOL knows how formidable my decks aren't :-)

--
